The '''Wasteland Core Mining Society''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] area located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bin Prime]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was situated in a deep valley with a bridge spanning across the divide.<ref name="EGTPM" />
